clips.title: The story
paras: On Darkshore, Sea Creature Bones come from massive marine carcasses washed ashore. Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde gathers skeletal samples for the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus, where the cause of the strandings is under investigation.

Massive sea creatures have begun flinging themselves onto Darkshore’s shallows, where they perish. Among them are giant threshers far larger than those native to the local waters. Night elves see the sudden increase as an ominous portent. Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde, sent by the Temple of the Moon to Auberdine, gathers bones from the beached creatures. Hippogryphs carry the specimens to Darnassus for close examination.

The immense carcasses attract local scavengers. Greymist murlocs gather around the dead and dying creatures, feeding on their remains and fiercely defending the feeding grounds. The murlocs are too weak to hunt beasts of this size, but investigators and adventurers must fight through their packs along Mist's Edge to recover bone fragments for study.
